questions.questionText: Among the staff in a Kochi office, 50 drink tea, 56 drink buttermilk and 13 drink both. How many drink only tea?
questions.explanation: Only tea = n(tea) − both = 50 − 13 = 37.
questions.shortcut: Only A = A − Both.

questions.questionText: Among the families in a Madurai colony, 21 watch IPL, 72 watch ISL and 10 watch both. How many watch only IPL?
questions.explanation: Only IPL = n(IPL) − both = 21 − 10 = 11.
questions.shortcut: Only A = A − Both.

questions.questionText: Among the people at a Kolkata book fair, 97 read The Telegraph, 53 read Times of India and 30 read both. How many read only The Telegraph?
questions.explanation: Only The Telegraph = n(The Telegraph) − both = 97 − 30 = 67.
questions.shortcut: Only A = A − Both.

questions.questionText: Among the customers at a Mumbai mall, 61 pay using Paytm, 37 pay using a credit card and 19 pay using both. How many pay using only Paytm?
questions.explanation: Only Paytm = n(Paytm) − both = 61 − 19 = 42.
questions.shortcut: Only A = A − Both.

questions.questionText: Of the commuters in Bengaluru surveyed, 29 use the metro, 22 use an auto-rickshaw and 8 use both. How many use exactly one of the two (either the metro or an auto-rickshaw but not both)?
questions.explanation: Exactly one = (A − both) + (B − both) = 29 + 22 − 2×8 = 35.
questions.shortcut: Exactly one = A + B − 2 × Both.

questions.questionText: Of the Class X students in Jaipur surveyed, 42 take Sanskrit, 82 take Social Science and 14 take both. How many take exactly one of the two (either Sanskrit or Social Science but not both)?

questions.questionText: Of the visitors to a Mysuru restaurant surveyed, 27 order dosa, 78 order vada and 19 order both. How many order exactly one of the two (either dosa or vada but not both)?

questions.questionText: Of the farmers in a Punjab village surveyed, 64 grow rice, 15 grow sugarcane and 4 grow both. How many grow exactly one of the two (either rice or sugarcane but not both)?

questions.questionText: Of 106 commuters in Bengaluru, 25 use neither the bus nor a bike taxi. 67 use a bike taxi, and 25 of those also use the bus. How many use the bus only?
questions.explanation: At least one = 106 − 25 = 81. Anyone not in a bike taxi but in the union is only the bus: 81 − 67 = 14.
questions.shortcut: Only A = Union − B.

questions.questionText: Of 98 commuters in Bengaluru, 0 use neither the bus nor a bike taxi. 79 use a bike taxi, and 10 of those also use the bus. How many use the bus only?
questions.explanation: At least one = 98 − 0 = 98. Anyone not in a bike taxi but in the union is only the bus: 98 − 79 = 19.

questions.questionText: Of 131 Class X students in Jaipur, 20 take neither Sanskrit nor Science. 51 take Science, and 21 of those also take Sanskrit. How many take Sanskrit only?
